chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from the one who mentioned it, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ali bin Yaqteen, who said:

I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): A man handed over one Hajj to five people, saying, 'Perform Hajj with it.' So a man from them performed it. He (peace be upon him) said: 'All of them are participants in the recompense.' I said: 'For whom is the Hajj?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'For the one who prayed in the heat and the cold.'
ai.seo_question: Who receives the primary reward for a shared Hajj pilgrimage?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (AS) addresses the fiqh of *shirkah* (partnership) in Hajj, clarifying that while the spiritual reward is shared among all contributors, the actual performance of the Hajj ritual is attributed to the one who physically undertook the journey and prayers. This distinction highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the integration of intention (*niyyah*) and physical action (*fi'l*) in determining the validity of shared religious obligations. The reference to 'heat and cold' underscores the endurance required for the ritual, linking the physical act to the spiritual merit.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from the one who mentioned it, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Yaqteen who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man handed over (the responsibility of performing) one Hajj to five people, so he said, ‘Perform Hajj with it’. So a man from them performed it’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘All of them are participants in the Recompense’. So I said, ‘For whom would be the Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the one who Prayed in the heat and the cold’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from those whom he has mentioned from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ali ibn Yaqtin who has said the following: “

I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who has given to five people for one al- Hajj; then says that one from among them perform al-Hajj. Then one man among them completes it. He (the Imam) said, ‘All of them have a share in the reward for al-Hajj.’ I then asked, ‘To whom belongs al-Hajj?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It belongs to the one who experiences hot and cold weather.’”
